reviews.text:
I’m incredibly grateful to Paws and Claws for everything they have done for Nelsito. After visiting several clinics throughout Miami, we finally found Dr. de Armas and a team that truly knew how to help him through a very serious case of heavy metal poisoning.

A special thank you to Jessica, who has been an angel to Nelsito from day one. Your guidance, knowledge, and the genuine love you show him have meant more to us than words can express. You’ve taught us so much and have been such an important part of his recovery.

Jessica, I know you’re on your journey to becoming a veterinarian, and I truly believe you’re going to be an amazing one. You have everything it takes. 🩷

Thank you as well to the wonderful girl at the front desk and the entire team for always being so kind and helpful. Knowing Nelsito is in such good hands gives us a kind of peace that is priceless. 🦜❤️

I had a fantastic experience at Paw and Clau Medical Center with Dr. Ramon for my dog’s spay surgery. From the quick check-in at 8 AM to the timely updates throughout the process, I felt completely at ease. They called me before and after the surgery to keep me informed, and I appreciated that they let me know when it was time to pick her up. The staff was caring and professional, making the entire experience calm and trustworthy. Highly recommend!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Our animals are so much more than pets. They are companions, family, and little souls who walk beside us through life's happiest and hardest moments. They love us without conditions, ask for so little, and give us everything they have. When the time comes to care for them, I believe it's our turn to honor that love by giving them the best care we can provide.

Othello has been part of my life for many years, and throughout that time the team at Paws and Claws has been there to help him whenever he needed it. Caring for exotic animals requires specialized knowledge that few veterinarians possess, and I'm grateful to have a team with that experience available when my little guy needs it most.

Veterinary medicine is never inexpensive, especially for exotic pets, but I've always looked at those moments as an investment in the health, comfort, and quality of life of a member of my family. There is no price on the peace of mind that comes from knowing you're doing everything you can for someone who has given you years of unconditional love.

Thank you to Dr. De Armas and the entire Paws and Claws team for the care you've shown Othello over the years. Wishing you all the very best, and thank you for everything you do for our beloved companions.

Apparently, a bad review can lead you to be barred from service.

I brought a ring neck bird named Jason who is underweight, yellow mouth, and lethargic. Mind you, I am scared for Jason and would of paid any price/convinced the person paying to save the him. Regardless, if the vet misdiagnosed or not.  Due to my abhorrent experience when I brought the ringneck, Jason, days ago with unnecessary costly charges for a weak bird that couldn't be diagnosed -with testing- by the vet who stated "I don't know what's wrong with the bird. You are denying everything and the bird is too weak for testing." The vet serviced a fecal matter test, antibiotics -for a bird he can't diagnose- and supplements to "keep the bird alive". I -a person who only had general knowledge of animals- knew that if a bird is not receiving nutrients from the food he is eating, that  it must be parasites. The bird should of also been prescribed an antiparasitic along with the antibiotics. I will give the vet grace for this miss step since the vet was upset with me for denying the extra charges without a concrete prognosis.

What is abhorrent and inane about this situation is that that vet is refusing to prescribe an antiparasitic -after getting the results for the fecal test-for a dying sick bird due to a bad review. I find this woefully unethical. A vet refusing to treat one of his patients due to a bad review from an owner's  bad review/experience is immoral. I'm sure that Jason -the sick ringneck- will pass away soon due to this ordeal since finding another avian vet in time to save his life is slim.

I pray that others will not go to this vet for any sick animal that is considered exotic. You best go make a long drive to homestead. Were more qualified diverse vets would be working.

Not a good experience, I took my pet there, they charge $115 just to see the animal.  Asked what was wrong and was responded you denied some test so as far as I know it can die in three days as it can survive.  They wanted to do so much test that I could buy another pet and safe money.  They take advantage that a pet owner is scared because their pet is sick.
Loved the care I got for my 5 lemurs! Can't believe I let them eat those glow sticks (silly me). Anyways doctor was great at curing my lemurs green disease. Regardless awesome clinic :)

I will preface this with saying that the vet has taken good care of our cookie (rip) and Chanel. He truly cares for the animals he looks after. I’m not sure if it was because Dr. De armas was not there today. But when I made this follow up appt. For Chanel I was told the visit would be 45 dollars. My husband took her and was told it would be 110 after services were rendered . They assumed that we would know that she needed another “flouristain” and did not show him an estimate prior to it. They claimed that they already told me when I made the appt about this prior to the appt. They didn’t.  My issue was the lack of transparency and Communication. The ASSUMPTION that we should already know.  When I called back for clarification - the tech proceeded to say “ we didn’t have to remove the hay from her eye”, and that “if 73 dollar is such a big deal Chanel could have been sent home with out the eye exam”. Also that “we could go else where”. Again, my issue was the lack of transparency, Communication,  and twisting the narrative to say I should have known how much it would be before I even pay … does that make sense??? I made it clear to the tech, not communicating is wrong. I’m not sure if they were very busy today, but I hope this is a learning lesson to communicate more effectively, amongst each other and the owners of the animals they care for.

They refused to see my bird even though it was 5 hours before closing time, first they said yes, bring him, then when I did the impossible, they still told me I needed to take him to an ER because 5 hours wasn’t enough. Once at the ER, they told me the vets are the best option because they are more knowledgeable doctors. They demonstrated is about them and not about our adopted kids. After 4 years, They lost me as customer, not that they care anyways.

We trust Dr. de Armas completely with our sugar gliders. Both of our girls had dental issues, and he performed surgery on each of them without any complications. If you’re looking for an experienced exotic pet veterinarian—especially if you have sugar gliders—we highly recommend Dr. de Armas. Your pets will be in excellent hands.

The staff was very polite. However, the Vet seemed rushed and  kept entering and exiting the room during the visit. At one point , not returning when I was waiting on my pet’s teeth to be checked, which I requested multiple times. The veterinarian suggested oral medicines, “just Incase he (my pet) is sick”, instead of checking him closely to make sure he is sick first before suggesting the meds. He said my hamster had “bumps on his eyes” because he didn’t look at him closely and I had to prove that it was bedding which he picked out with his fingers instead of using something gentle like a wet napkin. I felt like their goal wasn’t really to check nor did I feel like they even actually cared about him, it felt like they just wanted to prescribe stuff to make money. Which I didn’t appreciate. I do think the receptionist, the vet, and the vet techs were all very sweet but personally for the price just to be seen I’d prefer someone/place who’s not rushing and actually is inspecting the pet  thoroughly before suggesting/prescribing meds (that could potentially cause lots of damage btw) or just making assumptions of what’s wrong.

Don't recommend this Vet
On 05-19 Visit with my Rigneck Bird was week - Walking & singing But needed assistance care, I was expecting some antibiotic or something that will help the bird recover his strength, Instead it was recommended $ 600.00 Plus / Xray and blood test that will take 4-5 business day to get result. I mention what can be done to help Bird at the moment while we waited for the results
Why paid  $115.00 for a visit / no evaluation what so ever

My Bird died 45 minutes after leaving the Vet Office

Zero Star

I brought my bearded dragon in for concerns of his breathing pattern. His chest was having a lot of dramatic movement (with and without gaping). We saw a male vet who was very dismissive of our concerns. He is also an “exotic vet” but printed out a google sheet on what bugs he should be eating and how frequently, instead of answering our questions on the spot to confirm our husbandry was correct. When we showed multiple videos of our bearded dragon’s breathing patterns, he chalked it up to him “thermoregulating”. We left with our google sheet $130 later with a weird gut feeling that something still was not right with our bearded dragon.

2 weeks after this appointment, we went to VCA animal hospital in south dade for a second opinion, and saw an exotic vet who offered an x-ray for our bearded dragon. This vet found that our bearded dragon does in fact have either an upper respiratory infection, or scar tissue that formed from a prior upper respiratory infection, which was causing our bearded dragon to have distressed breathing. Our bearded dragon is now being treated with antibiotics and his x-ray is going to a radiologist for further evaluation.

I would never recommend Paws & Claws to anyone who truly cares for the best quality for their animals, exotic or not. I hope the vet sees this review and makes changes in his demeanor and learn from this mistake.

The service here is excellent. I visited this clinic because my hamster, Sirius Sarabi, had an eye infection. The care we received was incredible and fast. Hamsters usually get stressed when handled, but my little girl left the consultation feeling completely calm. The staff is highly professional and truly cares about the well-being of the animals.

I brought my canary, Julia, because she was very weak and not doing well. The care we received was absolutely amazing — the staff treated her with so much love, patience, and kindness. Thanks to them, my little Julita recovered, and I couldn’t be happier or more grateful! 💛🐤

Thank you for taking such beautiful care of her — it truly meant the world to me.

Excellent experience.
I took my little bird (a cockatiel) for its routine checkup and everything went perfectly.
The staff is very friendly and the doctor is amazing, incredibly patient and careful, especially since the bird was nervous and only a few months old. Their professionalism and love for animals are evident. Highly recommended!

Great service, staff are kind and friendly. Blue tongue skink was sick and the doctor identified the issue and helped bring him back to health smoothly. I would recommend this place to others, the doctor is responsible, thorough, and genuinely cares about the wellbeing of the animals.

I called and made an appointment for Wednesday 5pm. On Wednesday, I called again to let you know I would be late, I was told that the vet cannot wait, so I rescheduled for Friday 5pm. I was also told that I needed a credit card to make that rescheduling and would have a 120$ fee hold until the day of my new appointment. I agreed, the next day(Thursday) I check my credit card transactions and see two 120$ charges! Never was I told or notified of any cancelation fee at this point and certainly not by the woman having me on the phone on Wednesday. I then called again(Thursday morning) to cancel my Friday appointment. Courtesy to pay me 120$ back? I cancelled two working days before the appointment!

Had to bring my bearded dragon in for an emergency check-up and was able to schedule an appointment for the very next day. All of the staff were professional, knowledgeable and kind, and I was seated in an exam room promptly upon arrival. It's not always so easy to find a good exotic vet and you can tell that Dr. de Armas and his staff are serious about providing quality care for your animals.
Customer service is very “hurry up you’re just a number” based off my 3 minute wait time for two questions and the clearly inconvenienced receptionist I’m good.

This place is a scam. I brought my ferret who was very sick in yesterday for a physical which was $145. The doctor sees the ferret and tells me that they need to run test x-rays, etc. and it was gonna be $1300 just to tell me what was wrong. I asked how much an x-ray would be just to find that out. It was $345 just for an x-ray. The prices are ridiculous. An x-ray is free for the clinic. I ended up leaving with antibiotics and some other medicine for his stomach. The doctor was so unhelpful on what was actually wrong with the ferret just repeating that he can’t have any kind of diagnosis without all of these tests being run not even a guess. so $300 later I went home with my dying ferret. No compassion no real empathy for the pet. I was sent a formula to make for him which I did and I had one simple question on how much to give him because my syringes were different and no response. I later receive a follow up text asking how he’s doing, I respond with how he’s doing and I can ask the question bout the dosage of the formula and send a picture and no response. They don’t care about your pets. They only care about the money. So sad when money is what rules the hearts of vets not the pets. They are innocent animals and the owners are desperate for help but cannot always afford these inflated prices. I will be searching for help from a vet that still has love for his profession. One more thing as I am leaving he says “God bless you” I was left speechless after his lack of care for a living creature (God’s creature)

My boyfriend just called this place to get an estimate on how much it would cost to get our bunny neutered. While I understand every animal is different, let’s be real we are talking about a small bunny. How much of a variation in cost can there possibly be to neuter a bunny lol. On top of that they said it would be a 145 dollar consultation fee. What a scam.

Brought my 6 year old Quaker Yoshi here for the first time and was amazed at the care and concern they had for him. The doctor and staff answered our many many questions and treated not only Yoshi but us with so much kindness. I greatly appreciate and recommend them. If you are anxious just like I was before taking my little guy here I assure you your pet will have the best of care.

Tried to scam us.
We went there to try and see what they could tell us about my conures broken leg.
and the doctor confirmed to us that it was a broken leg and They gave us a price estimate of $800. The doctor said that the way he knew was because he felt his bone with his hand and knew it was out of place. Then later he told us that he knew because he took an X-ray (He took the x-ray before we decided to go through with any procedure, and we did not ask him to take an x-ray). We decided to go through with the procedure and then the doctor told us that he did not want to do the procedure because the birds bones were already mending. MIND YOU, HE TOLD US AFTER HE ALREADY SEDATED THE BIRD. Well, he’s about to bring us the bird when they tell us we have to pay $267 dollars for an x-ray. We NEVER approved or asked for an x-ray before we decided to go through with the procedure. He did the X-ray for himself before we even agreed to anything. Then later, they had the audacity to try to charge us for anesthesia that was given to the bird EVEN THOUGH he never actually did anything with the bird. He should’ve known that the bones were already mending BEFORE he gave the bird anything.

The doctor was nice and gave us some good info and tips, but the way he just tried to get money out of us, that’s where he lost a customer. Don’t come here if you don’t want to lose your money.

Thank you, Mia, for your outstanding 5-star rating! We appreciate your support and are dedicated to providing excellent care at Ramon de Armas - Avian and Exotics Veterinarian in Miami. Your satisfaction is our priority.
Thank you, Liza, for your wonderful 5-star rating! Your support is greatly appreciated, and we look forward to serving you and your avian or exotic companions in the future.

I brought my blue tongue skink here for some concerns I was having about his health.
The staff was very polite. There was a little bit of a wait to be seen, but it wasn’t a problem or anything excessive.
The doctor was professional and kind. He was thorough in explaining what kind of tests he recommended, and answered all of my annoying questions. I really appreciate his patience because I can be a big worrier when it comes to my pets.
I feel comfortable trusting them with my reptile’s veterinary needs and recommend them highly.
This is a great place to bring your rabbit. They are one of the few places in South Florida with rabbit vaccinations available. They also deal with other exotics like birds and reptiles.
Excellent
Thank you, K., for your wonderful 5-star rating! Your support means a lot to us at Paws and Claws Medical Center in Miami. We appreciate you taking the time to share your experience.
The vet at this clinic is extremely knowledgeable. He took the time to ease all of my concerns with my bird and did a thorough check up. I am so grateful to have such a great avian vet in Kendall!

Some time ago the place who had been clipping my Amazon parrot's wings and nails went out of business, and no store or vet in my area was providing this service.  My vet suggested Paws and Claws.  We had our first appointment with them this past week.  Everyone, starting with the woman who  handled the first contact on the phone to the tech who returned my very ill tempered but nicely trimmed parrot, was cheerful, gracious and helpful.
I was comfortable in the clean and efficient presentation of the business.
My interview with Dr.  Ramon de Armas left me assured that my grumpy parrot would be treated well and groomed safely.
Based on the experience Casper (the grump) and I received,  I heartedly recommend Paws and Claws.
Excellent service and very knowledgeable staff and the doctor is outstanding. I highly recommend this center.

Highly recommended! The entire team provides spectacular service; they are incredibly kind and patient with pets, answering all your questions with genuine care and kindness. I am so grateful for all their services.

Dr. de Armas is a very good veterinarian. I took a very ill bird here. The atmosphere was professional and compassionate and Dr. de Armas is very knowledgeable. Will recommend. Cute cockatiel bird in the waiting room also =]

It's so rare to come across a vet that handles birds and yet handles them so well. Jade always explains everything rather thoroughly and she is always super helpful. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone seeking care for their pet.
Thank you, tiychareigna, for your kind 5-star rating! We sincerely appreciate your support and are delighted to serve you at Paws and Claws Medical Center in Miami.

I am incredibly grateful to have had the opportunity to bring my chickens and rooster to Dr. Ramon de Armas, DVM, for assessment and evaluation. He graciously accommodated both me and my mom, and he, along with his staff, was exceptionally kind and knowledgeable. We are so fortunate to have his expertise available whenever needed. He took his time with each of my chickens, carefully collecting samples for further examination. I left with a deep sense of peace and reassurance.
Thank you,

🐓
Thank you for your generous 5-star rating, Cx! We appreciate your support for Paws and Claws Medical Center in Miami and look forward to serving you again in the future.
Very professional, friendly, and knowledgeable. 100% recommended.
Thank you, Kat, for your kind words and exceptional rating! We truly appreciate your support and are dedicated to providing the best care at Paws and Claws Medical Center in Miami.
Very good service

Excellent services. They really took a good care of my bird. He is much better now.
Thanks.
Excellent service. Polite, professional, utter attention to animal’s health and well being.  I strongly recommend them. Chika, my parakeet, express them her sincere gratitude.
Thank you, Daniela, for your kind words and for taking the time to leave a 5-star review! We appreciate your support for Paws and Claws Medical Center in Miami.
Thank you, Eduardo, for your kind review! We truly appreciate your support and are delighted to have had the opportunity to care for your pet at Paws and Claws Medical Center in Miami.

Excellent service. My chinchilla was very sick. They treated her with love and professionalism. They explained the entire treatment to me, and today my chinchilla is doing great! Running around like before ☺️

Best place ever for animals. My dogs loves the doctor and everyone there. My dogs are always happy to go even when getting a shot. Glad I found this doctor. Highly recommend them. We are truly blessed Paws and Claws exists because they truly are wonderful to our fur babies.
I’m so glad that I found guys , thanks god, the doctor and staff I will be with my Blanquita ♥️

Phenomenal care, facility, communication and support. The vet, the technicians and the receptionist beatriz were exceptionally excellent. They saved my rabbits life extremely quickly. They got my bunny seen and taken care of in a timely fashion while effectively treating her. Checking in with me each day post admission to see how my pet is doing. The patient care toward me and my pet were outstanding. Thank you guys for being so kind and care during such a stressful time. I cannot be more appreciative of you all for helping save my little bunny. This place was 40 minutes from me but well worth the drive. Thank you thank you thank you🙏🏻
Thank you, Doreen, for your kind words and wonderful rating. We appreciate your support and look forward to serving you and your pet again at Paws and Claws Medical Center in Miami.
Thank you, Camilla, for your kind words and 5-star rating. We truly appreciate your support for Paws and Claws Medical Center in Miami. Your satisfaction means a lot to us!
Very professional

0 stars. Not only does the Doctor have a bad attitude, but he had the audacity to sell me a product whose expiration date was 1 month after purchase. I would not recommend this business on anyone. Very expensive probably rips off customers to pay for the expense rent.
Thank you, Jasmine, for your wonderful feedback! We're delighted to hear you had a positive experience at Paws and Claws Medical Center in Miami. Your satisfaction means the world to us.
I must say they are truly amazing, the doctor has been very helpful and supportive on the care of my pet monkey. I’m extremely grateful for the positive experience and treatment we get every visit.

This an amazing practice !! They treated my dog (my third baby) very nice and kind 🥰 The clinic was very clean and professional environment. Since arriving, staff from the front desk greeted us and made us feel at home. I would definitely recommend Dr. De Armas and staff. …

I’m so grateful that I found this clinic when i did. The staff are all amazing & they express such warmth & care for all their patients, including my lil sulcata tort, helping him recover & get better. Their love for what they do is evident & I’m always met with genuine kindness each time I visit. 10/10 recommend 💖 …
I love the entire staff and they treated our puppy like royalty.

I would recommend Paws and Claws Medical Center for your beloved fur babies! The entire staff is very professional, welcoming, knowledgeable, and caring. They are easy to get in contact with and respond quickly. We are seen by Dr. Ramon and he has been very helpful and empathetic. The front staff are always friendly and responsive. The office is clean and organized and they always offer coffee and have treats out (for us humans)! My bunnies and I are very happy that we found them 💕
Dr. Ramon and his staff are very professional, knowledgeable, and friendly. Today was my second visit and I will continue to bring Chalky. Thank you 😊 …

I sincerely thank Dr. Ramon De Armas and the staff at Paws and Claws. My 5-year-old budgie, Limonchik, was showing signs of poisoning. When it comes to birds, finding the right place and the right veterinarian is truly challenging. With limited time, I consulted many people, read countless reviews, and ultimately decided that Paws and Claws was the right choice.

Dr. Ramon De Armas is a very understanding and helpful person. He quickly assessed my bird’s condition and promptly found a solution. Everyone at the clinic was incredibly kind and supportive, even as I arrived in a panic. They patiently showed me how to prepare and administer the medication my bird needed. I am deeply grateful to them.

Even though they are quite far from where I live, I am relieved to know that I now have a trustworthy place for my birds’ care.
Excellent service and care! The whole process was quick and easy and the team made sure my bird Tuti received the best care possible. I would definitely recommend them.
Staff is always friendly and professional thank you so much for taking care of my sweet babies 💃🏻💃🏻 …

They took such good care of my holland lop bunny. We are from out of town & I attend college in Miami, so it’s extremely helpful to have a caring vet here. Extremely gentle with small animals & lots of good advice regarding nutrition. Thank you !

Outstanding service! We came to visit due to an emergency with our cat on the 31st. The staff was genuine and the Dr. Was honest and thorough. They went above and beyond. They follow up even after our cat when to vet hospital. We will take our cat back for check up and to change vets as our primary once we return from trip. A must!
Dear Adriana, thank you for the 5-star rating. We are thrilled to hear about your positive experience at Paws and Claws Medical Center in Miami. We appreciate your kind feedback!

Thank you so much, Sylvia. We're so glad to hear you're happy with our service.
Paws and Claws Medical Center wishes you and your family a Happy 2019!

I loved visiting Paws and Claws Medical Center. My bunny and I felt well taken care of, with service and expertise that met our high expectations. I definitely recommend it and will certainly continue to visit.
Doctor was very pleasant and patient with my questions and helped me understand the care plan. Staff was also very kind and helpful. Highly recommend.
The most amazing experience always, the staff and vet are the most caring and gentle towards my fur babies, Ive brought my quinea pigs,rabbits,ferret and kittys and there is no other place for me.
Don't waste your money

exceptional care since my call to schedule my 1st appt till the office visit. the assistant and the doctor were very patient with me , answering all my questions    I really appreciate and congratulate the whole stuff .
They were very welcoming and helped my leopard gecko!!
Love the way my chameleon is being helped out here! Thanks to the staff, my chameleon is doing much better ! 💜🙏🏼 …
My experience with the veterinary clinic was very good, I recommend them 100% 🐾✨️🐾 …

My name is Sayling and a few days ago I went to this center with my Argentine parrot because of a certain condition it had, and as soon as I entered I felt warmth and sympathy for the pets and their families. My little bird was healthy from one day to the next 🙏🥰 like a miracle and all thanks to the incredible team that works there …
Extremely polite and helpful staff specifically in providing a very prompt appointment for my ball python. The doctor was helpful, knowledgeable and very kind. Thank you for your help guys
Excellent service! The dr and tech were extremely nice and informative when it came to my cockatoo 💙 The receptionist was so sweet. Glad to say I had a great first experience here 💕 …
Excellent service, I highly recommend them

The staff at paws and Claws is very sweet and loveable with your love one with four legs. The vet took the time to ask about the symptoms my kitten was experiencing and based on what I shared with him, the vet decided how to proceed with the check up and treatment. I was really happy on the way my kitten and I where taken care of.
They only care about your money, not your pet. They will not be honest about the prognosis, they only want you to leave your pet to bill you. …

I am very satisfied and pleased to have my Vet for Picasso, my Panther Chameleon who is almost 7 months old. Excellent service, Dr. Ramon is excellent as is his team. Very kind and dedicated to our babies. Thank you for your professionalism and love for animals.
Very professional, good service from the front desk to the doctor.
Mrs. Salcedo, Thank you for your rating; we look forward to continuing to support Mauricio back to health.
Great experience! I brought in my pet bird for an emergency consultation and the doctor was very attentive. Will definitely return if needed.

The place is great, but unfortunately, it's a bit overpriced for me. The entire team is wonderful, and I especially want to mention Jessica, who was incredibly helpful and kind. I'm very grateful for her assistance.

Paws and Claws is one of the few clinics that administer vaccines to rabbits! They have varying levels and categories of care too! The staff were also kind and understanding. Whenever Theo needs their help, he will be there. ❤️😊 …
